name: Council of AI — Measurement Agent
description: Independent AI-governance MEASUREMENT body. Publishes the GSPC 14-slot instrument (Governance · Safety · Provenance · Continuity) — 13 measured of 14 — with frozen item banks, published scoring code, and an Ed25519-signed board. Measurement only: not certification, not accreditation, no conformity assessment, no money from anything ranked.

skills.name: Signed GSPC Board
skills.description: Fetch the live Ed25519-signed GSPC 14-slot board (13 measured of 14): per-axis n, leader, Wilson interval, and McNemar separation. Live JSON, recomputable from published rows.

skills.name: Measured Badge
skills.description: Shields-style README badge stating a subject's measured-axis count; unmeasured subjects render honestly as 'unmeasured', never a fabricated score.

skills.name: East-West cross-jurisdiction board
skills.description: One signed measurement mapped across EU / UK / Illinois / China. Mapping is not a compliance determination. UNSIGNED on this stamp; Value Ledger count 0.

skills.name: MCP measured tools
skills.description: JSON-RPC tools/list and tools/call over live board APIs (gspc, east-west, ecosystem, verify-tally, benchmark-quality, instruments). Deterministic proxy — no LLM judges.

skills.name: Benchmark-quality register
skills.description: Fetch the signed register of what THIRD-PARTY AI benchmarks disclose about their own process integrity: contamination control, reproducibility, statistical rigour, scoring transparency, governance and conflicts of interest, item quality, licensing, saturation, failure disclosure. Deterministic predicates only — no language model judges anything. Every predicate answer carries the URL it was read from and the date it was fetched; a predicate that could not be checked is UNKNOWN with its reason. Records are unsolicited, the subjects did not participate, and nothing on the register is a certification, accreditation or endorsement. Council of AI's own instruments are structurally excluded by an impartiality firewall enforced in code. Filter one subject with ?benchmark=<id>.
